podcast.title: Co-hosting "Art Context" Podcast
podcast.body: Taj Krishmal is a co-host of the new podcast "Art Context: The Architects of Art." The podcast features conversations with music video storytellers about their creative journeys, aiming to highlight their often-overlooked contributions to impactful visual content. "We have Taj Khrishlo and Director X."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Experience in Music Video Industry
podcast.body: With over 20 years in the music video business, Taj Krishmal (and Director X) felt it was important to create a platform like "Art Context" to share the stories and processes of the creative artists behind music videos. "And coming from the world of music video, bringing the business for over 20 years, we felt it was necessary to create a show like Architects."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Origin from Brampton, Ontario
podcast.body: Taj Krishmal, along with Director X, are "two kids from Brampton, Ontario that went out to make art that broke out to the world," now using their podcast for audio storytelling. "And there were two kids from Brampton, Ontario that went out to make art that broke out to the world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transition to Audio Storytelling
xref.body: For the "Art Context" podcast, Director X (alongside Taj Krishmal) is transitioning from visual storytelling in music videos to audio storytelling. The podcast focuses on interviews with creators like Dave Meyers, discussing their philosophies, work, and broader issues like Black Lives Matter. "I mean, we're talking to the creators. So it's a different kind of thing. I mean, the story is the story of the maker."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
